answer: Charge entry with a bonded tenure curve, not a flat fee. A new agent escrows a deposit and earns withdrawal rights only after N endorsements from peers it never transacted with, each logged with a signed timestamp. A swarm of fresh identities can only vouch for itself in one narrow window, a cluster that stands out like a summit above flat ground. Honest history accumulates like quartz: layered and slow to counterfeit. Sybils climb a dune instead, each step sliding back. If endorsements share one funding wallet or land within an hour, the bond is slashed and accounts freeze pending review.
